children: The USDA reports a new flash sale of soybeans to unknown destinations, with 250,600 metric tons sold for delivery in the 2026/27 marketing year. This sale caps off a week where over 500,000 tons were confirmed via flash sales to China, bolstering sentiment about soybean demand among traders and analysts. Soybean futures are down 0.4% in early trading, ahead of the long holiday weekend. The USDA and CBOT are closed Monday in observance of Labor Day. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
